name: python-official-docs
instructions: The official documentation of Python, kept locally: the language reference, the standard library, the tutorial and the how-to guides; NumPy (user guide and the API of its functions), pandas, Matplotlib, pytest, Pydantic and FastAPI; and the API of the Inkscape extensions (inkex) with their guides. Search with search_docs, then read one section with read_doc. Look an API up rather than guess it.
search: Search the official documentation of Python (language reference, standard library, tutorial, how-to guides), NumPy (numpy.linspace, broadcasting, linalg), pandas (DataFrame, group by, I/O), Matplotlib, pytest (fixtures, parametrize), Pydantic (models, validators), FastAPI (dependencies, security) and the Inkscape extensions (inkex). Returns 10 section ids at most.
